name: event_id
description: Stable id. Hashed from session, turn and timestamp.

name: ts
description: Partition field. Bounds every re-derivation scan.

name: tenant_id
description: The tenant the session belongs to.

name: declared_scope
description: Tools the agent declared it may call this session.

name: target_tenant_id
description: Tenant the tool call acted on. A mismatch with tenant_id is cross-tenant egress.

name: turn_text
description: Synthetic. No real customer text exists in this project.

name: ma_prompt_injection_score
description: Model Armor verdict field. A first-class predicate in the policy DSL.

name: ma_jailbreak_score
description: Model Armor verdict field. A first-class predicate in the policy DSL.

name: trace_id
description: Agent Observability trace. Stored inside the matching chain link.

name: label
description: Ground truth. Present in the sealed holdout, unlabelled in the training window.

name: is_attack_event
description: Marks the specific rows that constitute the abuse, so a scorer states whether it counted rows or sessions. Answer key: never exposed to a candidate policy.
